brief.meaningEn: Calm someone’s thoughts before a demanding task.
brief.meaningZh: 在需要集中精神的事情前讓心緒平靜下來。
brief.grammar: Say settle my/his/her mind for one person, or settle their minds for several people. The exact source has group/their mind agreement tension; retain the source quote but model clear agreement.
brief.register: Preparation for tests, performances and difficult conversations.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課是讓思緒較平靜，不保證焦慮完全消失或事情必定成功。
brief.misconceptionZh: 來源句子須原樣保留作出處；教學例句則以清楚的單複數配搭示範。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用合適的代名詞和 mind／minds 描述讓自己或多人平靜的行動。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 2, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A quiet walk helped the group settle their mind before the test.

listening.promptZh: 散步對美怡有甚麼幫助？

options.en: It helped her think more calmly before speaking.
options.zh: 它幫助她在發言前較平靜地思考。

options.en: It removed every trace of nervousness.
options.zh: 它讓她完全不再緊張。

options.en: It changed the debate topic for her.
options.zh: 它替她改了辯論題目。

options.en: It made her skip the opening points.
options.zh: 它令她略過開場要點。

listening.explanationZh: 她較能平靜思考，但仍有點緊張。
listening.en: Before the debate, Mei took a short walk and reviewed her opening points. The quiet ten minutes helped settle her mind, though she was still a little nervous.
listening.zh: 辯論前，美怡散了一會步，重溫開場要點；安靜的十分鐘讓她心緒較平靜，雖然仍有點緊張。

reply.promptZh: （美怡為何在辯論前留一段安靜時間？）

options.en: She wanted to review her opening points.
options.zh: 她想重溫開場要點。

options.en: She wanted to feel calmer before speaking.
options.zh: 她想在發言前較平靜。

options.en: She hoped the walk would settle her mind.
options.zh: 她希望散步讓自己心緒平靜下來。

options.en: She used the break to organise her thoughts.
options.zh: 她利用休息時間整理思緒。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明她準備發言的用意；金句使用本課搭配。
reply.promptEn: Why did Mei take quiet time before the debate?

scene.promptZh: 演員上台前關掉手機，安靜地深呼吸，然後再看第一句台詞。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The short pause helped settle his mind before the performance.
options.zh: 短暫停頓讓他在演出前心緒較平靜。

options.en: The pause guaranteed a flawless performance.
options.zh: 這段停頓保證演出零失誤。

options.en: He decided not to perform after all.
options.zh: 他最後決定不演出。

scene.explanationZh: 暫停和深呼吸有助整理思緒，不保證演出結果。

contrast.promptZh: 若說的是五位同學一起平靜下來，哪個英文配搭較清楚？

options.en: The exercise helped settle their minds.
options.zh: 練習讓他們的心緒較平靜。

options.en: The exercise helped settle their mind, meaning one shared mind.
options.zh: 練習讓他們共用一個心思而平靜。

options.en: The exercise settled the exam questions for them.
options.zh: 練習替他們解決了試題。

contrast.explanationZh: 多個人的各自思緒用 their minds 較清楚；來源原句仍保留在出處欄。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們開會前都很急躁，如何先冷靜下來？」你想建議各人散步十分鐘並整理要點。哪句最完整？

options.en: A ten-minute walk and a quick outline may help settle our minds before the meeting.
options.zh: 散步十分鐘再簡單列要點，或能讓我們在開會前心緒較平靜。

options.en: We could each take a short walk before the meeting.
options.zh: 我們可以各自在開會前散步一會。

options.en: Writing down the main points may make the discussion easier.
options.zh: 寫下重點或可令討論更順利。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句提出兩個具體做法並使用適合多人情況的 our minds。

speaking.en: The quiet walk helped settle her mind before she spoke to the panel.
speaking.zh: 面見小組前，安靜散步讓她心緒較平靜。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再留意代名詞與 mind 的配搭。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：三位學生要向校董介紹新圖書角，會前他們各自散步五分鐘並重看提綱。用一至兩句英文說明準備的作用。
writing.selfCheckZh: 明確寫出三人各自的思緒變平靜，並保留會前準備；不要保證發表一定成功。

examples.en: A short walk and another look at the outline helped settle their minds before the presentation.
examples.zh: 短暫散步並再看提綱，讓他們在發表前心緒較平靜。

examples.en: The three students reviewed their notes to settle their minds, though they still had questions for the board.
examples.zh: 三名學生重溫筆記以讓心緒較平靜，雖然他們仍有問題想向校董提出。

takeaways.en: The pianist paused to settle her mind before the first note.
takeaways.zh: 鋼琴家在第一個音符前停一停，讓自己心緒平靜。

takeaways.en: The volunteers took a breath to settle their minds before meeting visitors.
takeaways.zh: 義工接待訪客前深呼吸，讓各自的心緒平靜。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Coordinate several daily commitments so the schedule remains workable.
brief.meaningZh: 把一天內幾項安排協調好，讓日程仍可運作。
brief.grammar: A plan or reminder can hold the day together figuratively; this is schedule coordination, not the emotional idiom hold it together.
brief.register: Planning errands, transport and family routines.
brief.boundaryZh: 可以承認仍有小延誤；重點是主要安排沒有互相撞散。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把本課解作某人強忍情緒，也不要把時間表當成成功保證。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明一份計劃如何把多項任務銜接起來。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 5, row 12; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A written plan helped hold the day together.

listening.promptZh: 卡片的主要作用是甚麼？

options.en: It helped him coordinate three commitments despite a delay.
options.zh: 即使遇上延誤，它仍幫他協調三項安排。

options.en: It made the bus arrive on time.
options.zh: 它令巴士準時抵達。

options.en: It cancelled the parcel pickup.
options.zh: 它取消了取包裹安排。

options.en: It replaced the clinic appointment.
options.zh: 它取代了覆診。

listening.explanationZh: 卡片協調時間和路線，卻沒有令巴士準時。
listening.en: On Saturday, Luis had a clinic visit, a parcel pickup and his daughter’s rehearsal. He wrote one route and three times on a card; the card helped hold the day together even when the bus was late.
listening.zh: 星期六，路易斯要覆診、取包裹和送女兒排練。他在卡上寫下一條路線和三個時間；即使巴士遲到，卡片也讓一天的安排仍可銜接。

reply.promptZh: （卡片星期六怎樣幫助路易斯？）

options.en: It listed the three times in one place.
options.zh: 它把三個時間列在同一處。

options.en: It helped him plan the route between tasks.
options.zh: 它幫他規劃幾項任務之間的路線。

options.en: It helped hold the day together.
options.zh: 它幫他把一天的安排銜接起來。

options.en: It gave him a way to adjust after the bus delay.
options.zh: 巴士延誤後，它讓他有依據調整安排。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明卡片的協調作用；金句用本課比喻。
reply.promptEn: How did the card help Luis on Saturday?

scene.promptZh: 社區活動日要先收貨、再佈置、最後接待訪客；一張共用時間表讓三隊人知道何時交接。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The shared timetable helps hold the day together.
options.zh: 共用時間表有助把一天的安排銜接起來。

options.en: The timetable guarantees that no visitor will arrive late.
options.zh: 時間表保證沒有訪客遲到。

options.en: The teams have stopped needing any handover.
options.zh: 三隊人已完全不需要交接。

scene.explanationZh: 時間表把多個步驟連起來，不保證所有人準時。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把 hold the day together 誤當成另一種情緒意思？

options.en: The plan links deliveries, setup and visitor arrival.
options.zh: 計劃連接收貨、佈置和訪客到場。

options.en: She hid her tears so nobody saw her upset.
options.zh: 她強忍眼淚，不讓人看出難過。

options.en: The route card keeps several appointments manageable.
options.zh: 路線卡讓幾項預約較易安排。

contrast.explanationZh: 強忍眼淚近於 hold it together 的情緒意思，本課講日程協調。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事問：「三隊人都在同一天工作，怎樣避免交接混亂？」你想用共享時間表。哪句最完整？

options.en: Let us use one shared timetable to hold the day together and mark each handover clearly.
options.zh: 我們用一份共用時間表把一天的安排串起來，清楚標示每次交接。

options.en: We can mark each team’s handover time on the sheet.
options.zh: 我們可以在表上標示每隊的交接時間。

options.en: Each team should see the same updated plan.
options.zh: 每隊都應看到同一份更新後的計劃。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出工具、協調作用和具體做法。

speaking.en: The route card held the day together when three appointments ran close to one another.
speaking.zh: 三項預約時間相近時，路線卡讓一天的安排仍可銜接。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出甚麼把日程連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校嘉年華上午要送貨，午間換場，下午開放給家長；義工用共用表列明交接。用一至兩句英文描述它如何幫助日程。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出至少兩項環節與交接安排；不要說一切意外都不會發生。

examples.en: The shared schedule helps hold the day together by linking morning deliveries with the midday room change.
examples.zh: 共用時間表把上午送貨和午間換場銜接起來，讓一天的安排不散亂。

examples.en: Clear handover times can hold the day together as volunteers move from setup to the afternoon family visit.
examples.zh: 義工由佈置轉入下午家長入場時，清楚的交接時間可讓安排維持順暢。

takeaways.en: During the busy festival, volunteers used a checklist to hold the day together.
takeaways.zh: 繁忙節日期間，義工利用清單把一天的安排串起來。

takeaways.en: A plan can hold the day together without preventing every delay.
takeaways.zh: 計劃可讓一天的安排保持連貫，卻未必防止所有延誤。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Develop or become clear gradually as successive details emerge.
brief.meaningZh: 隨着細節陸續出現而逐步展開或變得清楚。
brief.grammar: Events or an explanation can unfold; do not imply evidence itself intentionally arranges a purposeful order.
brief.register: Reports, investigations and explanations over time.
brief.boundaryZh: 逐步顯現不保證最後答案已確定，也不表示證據有自己的意圖。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能把 unfold 解作把紙張攤開，除非上下文真的談實物。
brief.outcomeZh: 能按時間順序描述細節如何逐步出現。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 15, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The evidence began to unfold in a clear and purposeful order.
sources.expression: unfold in a clear and purposeful order

listening.promptZh: 新資料令事情有甚麼變化？

options.en: More of the sequence became clear, though one key fact remained unknown.
options.zh: 事情經過漸漸清楚，但一項關鍵資料仍未知。

options.en: The team found the boat before hearing the radio call.
options.zh: 救援隊在接到無線電通話前已找到船。

options.en: The camera recording answered every question.
options.zh: 鏡頭錄像回答了所有問題。

options.en: The radio call proved the first report was false.
options.zh: 無線電通話證明最初報告是假的。

listening.explanationZh: 線索逐步補足經過，但位置仍未確認。
listening.en: At first the rescue team knew only that a boat was missing. A harbour camera, then a radio call, gave them more detail; the story began to unfold, but the boat’s location was still unknown.
listening.zh: 起初救援隊只知道一艘船失蹤；港口鏡頭和其後的無線電通話帶來更多細節，事情逐步明朗，但船隻位置仍未知。

reply.promptZh: （上午救援情況的描述如何變化？）

options.en: It gained new details from a camera and a radio call.
options.zh: 它從鏡頭和無線電通話得到新細節。

options.en: More details emerged step by step.
options.zh: 更多細節逐步出現。

options.en: The account began to unfold as more details arrived.
options.zh: 更多細節出現後，事情逐漸展開。

options.en: The team could describe more than it knew at first.
options.zh: 救援隊能說出的資訊比起初更多。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述資訊逐步出現；金句使用 unfold。
reply.promptEn: How did the rescue account change during the morning?

scene.promptZh: 展覽籌辦者先知道三箱文物遲到，之後才收到運輸紀錄與倉庫確認；仍未知道確切到貨時間。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The account of the delay is unfolding as records arrive.
options.zh: 隨着紀錄送到，延誤的經過逐步清楚。

options.en: Every item has already been delivered.
options.zh: 所有文物已送達。

options.en: The records deliberately arranged themselves into a plan.
options.zh: 紀錄有意自行排成一份計劃。

scene.explanationZh: 紀錄帶來逐步了解，不代表貨物已送達或資料有意圖。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不支持「the explanation is unfolding」？

options.en: A new witness adds another part of the timeline.
options.zh: 新證人補充時間線另一部分。

options.en: No new detail appears and the account remains exactly as it was.
options.zh: 沒有新細節出現，說法完全沒有變化。

options.en: Two records clarify what happened before the call.
options.zh: 兩份紀錄釐清通話前發生甚麼。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有新增細節或進展，就談不上逐步顯現。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「現在知道為何活動取消嗎？」你只看到新證詞陸續出現，仍無最後結論。哪句最完整？

options.en: The explanation is still unfolding as witnesses speak; we should wait before claiming a final cause.
options.zh: 證人陸續發言，解釋仍在逐步形成；現在不宜斷言最後原因。

options.en: New witness accounts are adding to the timeline.
options.zh: 新證詞正在補充時間線。

options.en: The final cause has not yet been confirmed.
options.zh: 最後原因尚未確認。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句保留資訊逐步出現與結論未定兩點。

speaking.en: The full account unfolded over several days as the missing records arrived.
speaking.zh: 隨着缺失紀錄送到，完整經過在數天內逐步明朗。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出細節如何逐步出現。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：戲劇社原本只知排練室漏水；上午收到清潔報告，下午收到維修照片，仍未確定何時重開。用一至兩句英文描述資訊如何逐步明朗。
writing.selfCheckZh: 按先後提到兩項新資料，並保留重開時間未定。

examples.en: The account of the leak unfolded as the cleaning report and repair photos arrived, though reopening remains uncertain.
examples.zh: 清潔報告和維修照片陸續送到後，漏水經過逐步清楚，但重開時間仍未定。

examples.en: The explanation is unfolding: the morning report and afternoon photos add detail, but the room has no confirmed reopening time.
examples.zh: 事情仍在逐步明朗：上午的報告與下午的照片補充了細節，但房間尚無確定的重開時間。

takeaways.en: The sequence unfolded gradually as three witnesses shared different parts of it.
takeaways.zh: 三名證人各自補充一部分後，事情經過逐步顯現。

takeaways.en: A developing story may unfold without giving a final answer immediately.
takeaways.zh: 事情可以逐步明朗，卻未必立即得出最後答案。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Increase pressure on someone; in the source, prolonged silence creatively heightens suspense for an audience.
brief.meaningZh: 逐步加強對人的壓力；來源用沉默加深觀眾的懸念，屬延伸用法。
brief.grammar: Tighten the screws normally describes growing pressure on a person or group; staging and silence can extend it to suspense.
brief.register: Negotiations, deadlines and creative discussion of suspense.
brief.boundaryZh: 不要把導演的沉默誤解成真的扭緊螺絲，也不要把懸念用法當作唯一常見意思。
brief.misconceptionZh: 加壓可以是時間或要求增加，未必代表威脅或懲罰。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清對人施壓的常見意思與劇場懸念的創意延伸。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 22, row 12; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The director used silence to tighten the screws.

options.en: It increased suspense before the reveal.
options.zh: 它在揭曉前加深了懸念。

options.en: It told the audience the letter had been found.
options.zh: 它告訴觀眾信件已找到。

options.en: It shortened the scene by five seconds.
options.zh: 它令該場戲縮短五秒。

options.en: It made the actors tighten physical screws on stage.
options.zh: 它讓演員在台上扭緊實際螺絲。

listening.explanationZh: 沉默延長等待，產生懸念；這是比喻延伸。
listening.en: The theatre director left five seconds of silence before revealing the missing letter. With each silent second, she seemed to tighten the screws, keeping the audience in suspense.
listening.zh: 劇場導演在揭示失蹤信件前留了五秒沉默；每一秒的沉默都讓懸念加深，觀眾焦急地等候答案。

reply.promptZh: （信件揭曉前的停頓有甚麼效果？）

options.en: It made the audience wait longer for the answer.
options.zh: 它令觀眾等答案等得更久。

options.en: It raised tension in the scene.
options.zh: 它提高了該場戲的緊張感。

options.en: It tightened the screws before the reveal.
options.zh: 它在揭曉前進一步加深懸念。

options.en: It made the eventual reveal feel more dramatic.
options.zh: 它令其後揭曉更有戲劇效果。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述停頓如何增加懸念；金句用來源的延伸用法。
reply.promptEn: What did the pause do before the letter was revealed?

scene.promptZh: 談判最後一天，買方縮短答覆期限並要求對方再減價。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The buyer is tightening the screws on the seller.
options.zh: 買方正逐步加強對賣方的壓力。

options.en: The buyer has accepted every term without discussion.
options.zh: 買方已不經討論接受所有條款。

options.en: The seller has already left the negotiation.
options.zh: 賣方已退出談判。

scene.explanationZh: 縮短期限兼要求減價是對對方加壓的常見用法。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句屬於本課片語的字面動作，而不是比喻？

options.en: The examiner reduces the time allowed for a decision.
options.zh: 考官縮短作決定的時間。

options.en: The mechanic uses a tool to tighten screws on a bicycle.
options.zh: 機械師用工具扭緊單車上的螺絲。

options.en: A director extends silence before an answer.
options.zh: 導演在答案前延長沉默。

contrast.explanationZh: 機械師真的扭緊螺絲；其他情況屬加壓或加深懸念。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「為甚麼導演在答案揭曉前突然停下來？」你知道她想延長等待。哪句最完整？

options.en: She used the silence to tighten the screws and make the audience wait for the answer.
options.zh: 她以沉默加深懸念，讓觀眾等候答案。

options.en: The silence left the audience waiting longer.
options.zh: 沉默讓觀眾等得更久。

options.en: She delayed the reveal for dramatic effect.
options.zh: 她延遲揭曉以增加戲劇效果。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句同時說出方法與懸念效果，沒有誤解成字面動作。

speaking.en: The director tightened the screws with a long pause before the final answer.
speaking.zh: 導演在最後答案前長時間停頓，讓懸念進一步加深。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出壓力或懸念如何增加。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一間出版社要在星期五前決定是否採購設計公司的方案。採購方把回覆期限提早一天，又要求設計公司補交詳細報價。用一至兩句英文描述對設計公司的壓力。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出提早期限與補交報價怎樣加壓；這次要用對人施壓的常見意思，不要寫劇場懸念。

examples.en: The publisher tightened the screws on the design team by moving the deadline forward and asking for a detailed quote.
examples.zh: 出版社提前期限，又要求詳細報價，進一步向設計團隊施壓。

examples.en: By demanding a revised price list a day earlier, the buyer tightened the screws on the designers before Friday’s decision.
examples.zh: 採購方要求提早一天提交修訂價目表，在星期五決定前向設計師加壓。

takeaways.en: The manager tightened the screws by moving the deadline forward.
takeaways.zh: 經理把期限提前，進一步加大壓力。

takeaways.en: The final silence tightened the screws for the audience before the result appeared.
takeaways.zh: 結果出現前的最後一段沉默，令觀眾更感緊張。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Learn or take in habits gradually through repeated experience.
brief.meaningZh: 透過反覆經驗，隨時間逐漸學會習慣或做法。
brief.grammar: Habits can be absorbed over time; this passive construction does not imply a single intentional lesson.
brief.register: Learning routines in school, work or community life.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是漸進，不表示第一天就完全掌握，也不是液體被吸收。
brief.misconceptionZh: 反覆參與可能幫助學習，但應保留個別人的差異。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述一項習慣如何在多次參與後逐步形成。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 28, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The habits were absorbed over time at school.

listening.promptZh: 義工如何學會洗手習慣？

options.en: By watching and practising it across several Saturdays.
options.zh: 透過多個星期六的觀察與練習。

options.en: By hearing one lecture and never practising.
options.zh: 只聽一次講解，從不練習。

options.en: By reading a single notice without joining the kitchen.
options.zh: 不參與廚房，只看一張告示。

options.en: By absorbing soap into their hands.
options.zh: 讓肥皂被雙手吸收。

listening.explanationZh: 習慣來自多次觀察和練習，不是一次講解或字面吸收。
listening.en: New volunteers joined the community kitchen each Saturday. They watched the hand-washing routine and practised it repeatedly; the habit was absorbed over time, not learned in one lecture.
listening.zh: 新義工每星期六參與社區廚房，看着洗手程序並反覆練習；這習慣是逐漸學會的，不是聽一次講解便掌握。

reply.promptZh: （洗手程序怎樣讓義工變得熟悉？）

options.en: They saw the routine each week.
options.zh: 他們每週都看到程序。

options.en: They tried the steps repeatedly.
options.zh: 他們反覆練習步驟。

options.en: The habit was absorbed over time.
options.zh: 這習慣是隨時間逐漸學會的。

options.en: Several sessions helped them remember the process.
options.zh: 多次活動幫他們記住流程。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都反映反覆經驗；金句概括漸進吸收。
reply.promptEn: How did the hand-washing routine become familiar to volunteers?

scene.promptZh: 新同事每週跟資深員工整理檔案，逐步學會命名規則；第一天仍會弄錯。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The naming habit was absorbed over time through practice.
options.zh: 命名習慣透過練習隨時間逐漸學會。

options.en: She mastered every rule on the first morning.
options.zh: 她第一天早上就完全掌握每條規則。

options.en: The files physically absorbed the labels.
options.zh: 檔案在字面上吸收了標籤。

scene.explanationZh: 反覆整理帶來漸進學習，並非即時完全掌握。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不符合 absorbed over time？

options.en: A pupil gradually adopts a checking habit after weeks of practice.
options.zh: 學生練習數週後逐漸養成核對習慣。

options.en: A worker attends one briefing and instantly masters every procedure.
options.zh: 員工只聽一次簡介就即時完全掌握所有程序。

options.en: A trainee becomes familiar with greetings through repeated shifts.
options.zh: 見習生經多次輪班逐漸熟悉招呼方式。

contrast.explanationZh: 一次活動就立刻掌握全部程序，不符合逐步吸收。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「新義工怎樣學會整理收據？我們只講解過一次。」你知道他們其後連續幾週一起實做。哪句最完整？

options.en: The routine was absorbed over time through the weekly practice, not just that first explanation.
options.zh: 這做法是經每週實做逐漸學會的，不只是靠第一次講解。

options.en: They practised the receipt routine together for several weeks.
options.zh: 他們連續幾週一起練習整理收據。

options.en: The first explanation gave them a starting point.
options.zh: 第一次講解讓他們有個起點。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句區分起初講解與後續反覆實做。

speaking.en: The filing habit was absorbed over time through many ordinary workdays.
speaking.zh: 這種歸檔習慣是在許多平常工作日中逐漸學會的。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出重複經驗如何形成習慣。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校園導覽新義工每週帶訪客走同一條路線，一開始常忘記無障礙入口，幾星期後自然會提醒訪客。用一至兩句英文說明習慣如何形成。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出每週實做及數週後改善；不要說一次講解已足夠。

examples.en: The habit of pointing out the accessible entrance was absorbed over time as volunteers guided visitors each week.
examples.zh: 義工每週帶訪客後，主動指出無障礙入口的習慣是隨時間逐漸學會的。

examples.en: The practice was absorbed over time through repeated tours; after several weeks, volunteers remembered the accessible entrance.
examples.zh: 這種做法透過反覆導覽逐漸養成；數週後，義工記得無障礙入口。

glossary.en: The habit of pointing out the accessible entrance
glossary.zh: 主動指出無障礙入口的習慣

takeaways.en: A careful checking habit was absorbed over time during the training programme.
takeaways.zh: 細心核對的習慣在訓練期間逐漸養成。

takeaways.en: The greeting routine was absorbed over time, not mastered after one demonstration.
takeaways.zh: 招呼程序是隨時間逐漸學會的，不是看一次示範便掌握。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

brief.meaningEn: Not entirely clear in someone’s memory.
brief.meaningZh: 某段記憶並不十分清晰。
brief.grammar: Blurry can describe a picture literally or a memory figuratively; this source concerns a memory after many years.
brief.boundaryZh: 記憶模糊不等於確定記錯，也不等於整件事完全忘記。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 a little 誇大成完全沒有印象。
brief.outcomeZh: 能審慎描述仍有印象但細節未清的往事。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 36, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The memory is a little blurry after many years.

listening.promptZh: 麗娜對音樂會記得甚麼？

options.en: She remembers taking part but not the song order.
options.zh: 她記得曾參與，卻記不起歌曲次序。

options.en: She knows the exact order of every song.
options.zh: 她知道每首歌的準確次序。

options.en: She has forgotten that the concert happened.
options.zh: 她連音樂會曾舉行也忘了。

options.en: She now believes she attended a different school.
options.zh: 她現在相信自己讀過另一所學校。

listening.explanationZh: 她記得參與，只有歌曲次序不清楚。
listening.en: Lena remembers singing at the old school concert, but she cannot recall which song came first. After twelve years, that part of the memory is a little blurry.
listening.zh: 麗娜記得曾在舊校音樂會唱歌，但想不起哪首歌先唱；十二年後，這部分記憶有點模糊。

reply.promptZh: （麗娜對舊音樂會的記憶有多確定？）

options.en: She recalls singing there, although some details are unclear.
options.zh: 她記得在場唱歌，但部分細節不清楚。

options.en: She cannot name the first song with confidence.
options.zh: 她不能肯定地說出第一首歌。

options.en: Her memory of the sequence is a little blurry.
options.zh: 她對先後次序的記憶有點模糊。

options.en: She remembers the event more clearly than its order.
options.zh: 她對活動本身的記憶比次序清楚。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都保留部分記得、部分不清；金句使用目標表達。
reply.promptEn: How certain is Lena about the old concert?

scene.promptZh: 訪問者問十年前旅行第一天吃了甚麼；志明記得餐廳在海邊，卻不敢肯定菜式。哪句最貼切？

options.en: His memory of the meal is a little blurry.
options.zh: 他對那餐飯的記憶有點模糊。

options.en: He can list every dish in order.
options.zh: 他能依次列出每道菜。

options.en: He is sure the trip never happened.
options.zh: 他確定那次旅行從未發生。

scene.explanationZh: 他仍記得餐廳位置，只是不肯定菜式。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把「有點模糊」說得過於絕對？

options.en: I recall the venue, but not the exact date.
options.zh: 我記得地點，但不記得確切日期。

options.en: I remember nothing at all about the event.
options.zh: 我對整件事完全沒有印象。

options.en: The order of events is not fully clear to me.
options.zh: 我對事情先後並不完全清楚。

contrast.explanationZh: 完全沒有印象比 a little blurry 強得多。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「你肯定那次演出是星期五嗎？」你記得演出，卻未查到日期。哪句最完整？

options.en: I remember the performance, but the date is a little blurry, so I would check the programme.
options.zh: 我記得那場演出，但日期有點模糊，所以會查節目單。

options.en: I remember seeing the performance.
options.zh: 我記得看過那場演出。

options.en: The programme might have the date.
options.zh: 節目單可能有日期。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句清楚標示不確定之處和核實方法。

speaking.en: The trip itself stands out, but the order of our stops is a little blurry.
speaking.zh: 旅程本身印象深刻，但各站的先後次序有點模糊。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出哪部分記得、哪部分未確定。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：畢業生記得十年前參加過校園義賣，也記得一位老師幫忙，卻想不起當日攤位的排列。用一至兩句英文審慎描述記憶。
writing.selfCheckZh: 同時保留已記得的事實和未確定的細節；不要說全忘了。

examples.en: I remember the school sale and the teacher who helped, but the layout of the stalls is a little blurry.
examples.zh: 我記得校園義賣和幫忙的老師，但攤位排列的記憶有點模糊。

examples.en: Even now, the sale feels familiar, yet the order of the stalls is a little blurry.
examples.zh: 即使到了現在，我仍對義賣有印象，但攤位次序有點模糊。

takeaways.en: I recall the meeting, but the exact time is a little blurry.
takeaways.zh: 我記得那次會議，但確切時間有點模糊。

takeaways.en: Her memory of the first rehearsal is a little blurry after so many years.
takeaways.zh: 這麼多年後，她對首次綵排的記憶有點模糊。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

lessons.titleEn: a first alert rather than a final answer
lessons.titleZh: 初步警示而非最後答案

target.pattern: \ba first alert rather than a final answer\b

brief.meaningEn: Treat a message as an early warning that warrants checking, not a conclusive explanation.
brief.meaningZh: 把訊息視為值得查證的初步警示，而非已有定論。
brief.grammar: The source is a contextual contrast, not an established fixed idiom; first alert and final answer may be adapted to the situation.
brief.register: Posts, reports and early incident notices.
brief.boundaryZh: 初步警示值得留意，但不能單憑它下最後判斷。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是說初步訊息一定錯誤；只是證據尚未足夠。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分需要跟進的訊號和經查證的結論。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 60, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Treat the post as a first alert rather than a final answer.
sources.expression: a first alert rather than a final answer

options.en: The photo raised a concern but did not establish the cause.
options.zh: 照片引起關注，卻未能確定成因。

options.en: The photo proved exactly which pipe was broken.
options.zh: 照片已證明哪條水管壞了。

options.en: The resident had already completed a laboratory test.
options.zh: 居民已完成化驗。

options.en: The office had decided the water was safe without checking.
options.zh: 辦事處未檢查便斷定食水安全。

listening.explanationZh: 貼文提供線索，成因仍須測試。
listening.en: A resident posted a photo of cloudy tap water. For the housing office, the image was a first alert rather than a final answer; staff arranged a water test before naming a cause.
listening.zh: 居民上載了一張混濁自來水照片；對房屋辦事處而言，照片是初步警示，而非最後答案，職員先安排水質測試才判斷成因。

reply.promptZh: （房屋辦事處應如何運用居民的貼文？）

options.en: Use it to identify a concern worth investigating.
options.zh: 用它找出值得調查的疑慮。

options.en: Arrange a test before drawing a firm conclusion.
options.zh: 在作出確定結論前安排測試。

options.en: Treat it as a first alert rather than a final answer.
options.zh: 把它視為初步警示，而非最後答案。

options.en: Follow up on the report while leaving the cause open.
options.zh: 跟進報告，同時暫不判定成因。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都主張跟進而不倉卒定論；金句表達來源對比。
reply.promptEn: How should the housing office use the resident’s post?

scene.promptZh: 一位家長報稱課室有異味，校方尚未檢查通風設備。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The report is a first alert rather than a final answer about the cause.
options.zh: 報告是成因的初步警示，而非最後答案。

options.en: The report proves the air-conditioning unit is faulty.
options.zh: 報告已證明冷氣機故障。

options.en: There is no reason to inspect the classroom.
options.zh: 沒有理由檢查課室。

scene.explanationZh: 報告值得查證，但未確定來源。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個做法最符合「初步警示」與「最後答案」的分別？

options.en: Publish a definite cause from one untested photograph.
options.zh: 單憑一張未核實照片公布確定成因。

options.en: Record the report, investigate it, then state what the evidence supports.
options.zh: 記錄報告、展開調查，再按證據說明結果。

options.en: Discard the report before anyone checks it.
options.zh: 未經查證就把報告丟掉。

contrast.explanationZh: 先跟進，再根據證據作結論，符合兩階段分別。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事問：「社交平台貼文是否已解釋停電原因？」你只知道工程隊正在檢查。哪句最完整？

options.en: The post is a first alert rather than a final answer; the engineers are still checking the cause.
options.zh: 貼文是初步警示，而非最後答案；工程人員仍在查證成因。

options.en: The engineers are checking the site.
options.zh: 工程人員正在現場檢查。

options.en: The post drew attention to the outage.
options.zh: 貼文讓人注意到停電。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句同時保留貼文作用和成因未定。

speaking.en: For our team, the message was a first alert rather than a final answer, so we checked the equipment.
speaking.zh: 對我們團隊而言，這訊息是初步警示而非最後答案，因此我們檢查了設備。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出警示與查證的先後。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：有人在網上說社區中心的升降機有異響；職員立即停用並安排技工檢查，但仍未知哪個零件有問題。用一至兩句英文說明如何看待貼文。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出貼文促使採取行動，卻未能確定故障零件。

examples.en: The online post was a first alert rather than a final answer; staff stopped the lift and asked a technician to inspect it.
examples.zh: 網上貼文是初步警示而非最後答案；職員停用升降機，並請技工檢查。

examples.en: Staff treated the noise report as a first alert rather than a final answer, since the faulty part was still unknown.
examples.zh: 職員把異響報告視為初步警示而非最後答案，因為故障零件仍未知。

takeaways.en: A complaint can be a first alert rather than a final answer while an inspection is pending.
takeaways.zh: 檢查尚未完成時，投訴可以是初步警示，而非最後答案。

takeaways.en: The first report was a first alert rather than a final answer, so the team sought more evidence.
takeaways.zh: 首份報告是初步警示而非最後答案，因此團隊繼續蒐證。

notes: AI-authored provisional proposal; independent English, Chinese, media and browser QA remain pending.

lessons.titleEn: good for X, but often necessary for Y
lessons.titleZh: 有助起步，但精準執行通常需要細節

brief.meaningEn: A broad plan helps a group start, while detailed planning is often needed for exact execution.
brief.meaningZh: 概略計劃幫團隊開始行動，細節計劃通常令執行更準確。
brief.grammar: The source makes an unequal contrast: good for movement versus often necessary for precision, not an absolute rule for every task.
brief.register: Projects requiring both momentum and accuracy.
brief.boundaryZh: 不是說概略計劃毫無用處，也不是說每項小事都必須有繁複文件。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要保留 often，避免把「通常必要」說成所有情況無例外。
brief.outcomeZh: 能解釋起步和精準執行需要不同程度的規劃。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 116, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The project taught us that general plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision.
sources.expression: general plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision

listening.promptZh: 為何印標籤前要核對細節？

options.en: The broad theme helped them begin, but labels required exact facts.
options.zh: 大方向讓他們開始，標籤卻需要準確資料。

options.en: The exhibition theme meant dates no longer mattered.
options.zh: 有展覽主題後，日期便不重要。

options.en: The team could not begin gathering objects until every label was printed.
options.zh: 所有標籤印好前，團隊不能開始蒐集展品。

options.en: Precise spelling was needed only to choose the theme.
options.zh: 準確拼寫只用於選擇主題。

listening.explanationZh: 大方向推動開始；出版標籤需核對精確資料。
listening.en: The museum team agreed on a broad exhibition theme and could start gathering objects. Before printing labels, it drew up exact dates and spellings: general plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision.
listening.zh: 博物館團隊先定展覽大方向，便能開始蒐集展品；印製標籤前，他們核對確切日期和拼寫：概略計劃有助起步，但準確執行通常需要詳細計劃。

reply.promptZh: （博物館團隊為何既定大方向，又製作詳細清單？）

options.en: The theme gave the work a starting direction.
options.zh: 主題為工作提供起步方向。

options.en: The list helped them check dates and spellings.
options.zh: 清單幫他們核對日期和拼寫。

options.en: General plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision.
options.zh: 概略計劃有助起步，細節計劃通常對準確執行不可少。

options.en: They needed to begin work and avoid factual errors.
options.zh: 他們需要開始工作，也要避免事實錯誤。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均說明大方向與細節各有作用；金句保留 often。
reply.promptEn: Why did the museum team use both a broad theme and a detailed list?

scene.promptZh: 活動團隊已定義賣目標並招募義工；發送訂購表前，要核對價錢、數量和截止時間。哪句最貼切？

options.en: General plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision; check the order form now.
options.zh: 概略計劃有助起步，但準確執行通常需要詳細計劃；現在應核對訂購表。

options.en: The goal makes every figure on the form optional.
options.zh: 有了目標，表上的數字都可有可無。

options.en: They should cancel the sale until every future detail is known.
options.zh: 所有未來細節都知道前，應取消義賣。

scene.explanationZh: 開始籌備與準確發表資料是不同要求。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把來源對比說得過於絕對？

options.en: A rough outline can help a team start.
options.zh: 粗略大綱可幫團隊起步。

options.en: Every task without exception needs a long written plan.
options.zh: 任何工作毫無例外都需要一份冗長書面計劃。

options.en: Exact figures usually matter before publication.
options.zh: 公布前通常要核對準確數字。

contrast.explanationZh: 來源只說詳細計劃 often necessary for precision，不作無例外主張。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「既然已有活動方向，還要做細節表嗎？」你知道週五要公布集合時間和路線。哪句最完整？

options.en: General plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision; check the time and route before Friday’s notice.
options.zh: 概略計劃有助起步，詳細計劃通常令執行更準確；星期五公布前要核對時間與路線。

options.en: The general direction helped us start.
options.zh: 大方向幫我們開始。

options.en: The time and route should be checked.
options.zh: 應核對時間與路線。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句連結來源對比與具體待核對事項。

speaking.en: General plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision.
speaking.zh: 概略計劃有助起步，但準確執行通常需要詳細計劃。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再留意 good 與 often necessary 的分別。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生先用簡短構想獲准辦科學展；印海報前，他們要核對日期、房間號碼和安全規則。用一至兩句英文說明兩種規劃的作用。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出構想幫助起步，以及公布前核對細節；保留「有助」與「通常需要」的強弱差別。

examples.en: A rough outline is good for getting started, but a detailed checklist is often necessary for accuracy; the students checked the date before printing.
examples.zh: 粗略大綱有助起步，但詳細清單通常是確保準確所需的；學生印製前核對了日期。

examples.en: A short proposal is good for getting started, but exact room and safety details are often necessary for accurate posters; the team checked the room before printing.
examples.zh: 簡短提案有助起步，但要做出資料準確的海報，通常還需要確切的房間及安全資訊；團隊印製前核對了房間。

takeaways.en: General plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision when a timetable goes public.
takeaways.zh: 時間表公布時，概略計劃有助起步，但準確執行通常需要詳細計劃。

takeaways.en: General plans are good for movement, but detailed plans are often necessary for precision in a safety drill.
takeaways.zh: 安全演習中，概略計劃有助起步，但準確執行通常需要詳細計劃。

lessons.titleEn: train the person, not just the body
lessons.titleZh: 培養整個人，而不只練體能

brief.meaningEn: Develop judgment, character and cooperation as well as physical skills.
brief.meaningZh: 訓練判斷力、品格和合作能力，同時重視身體技能。
brief.grammar: The source contrasts whole-person development with body-only training; it does not reject physical practice.
brief.boundaryZh: 不只是身體訓練，不等於停止體能訓練。
brief.misconceptionZh: 「person」指學員作為完整的人，並非另有一名人士接受訓練。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述教練如何兼顧體能與判斷、合作。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 188, row 6; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A good academy aims to train the person, not just the body.
sources.expression: train the person, not just the body

listening.promptZh: 教練希望學員有甚麼成長？

options.en: They should build physical skill and sound judgment together.
options.zh: 他們應同時培養體能技巧和良好判斷。

options.en: They should stop all physical training.
options.zh: 他們應停止所有體能訓練。

options.en: They should make decisions without listening to teammates.
options.zh: 他們應不聽隊友意見便作決定。

options.en: They should focus only on rowing speed.
options.zh: 他們應只重視划艇速度。

listening.explanationZh: 俱樂部仍練體能，同時培養合作和判斷。
listening.en: At the rowing club, trainees still practised strength and balance. They also learned to listen to teammates and make safe decisions: the coaches wanted to train the person, not just the body.
listening.zh: 划艇會的學員仍練力量和平衡，也學聆聽隊友及作安全決定；教練希望培養整個人，而不只練體能。

reply.promptZh: （划艇會希望培養學員哪些能力？）

options.en: They want stronger rowing skills and safer decisions.
options.zh: 他們希望學員划艇更好，決定也更安全。

options.en: They teach trainees to work with teammates.
options.zh: 他們教學員與隊友合作。

options.en: They aim to train the person, not just the body.
options.zh: 他們希望培養整個人，而不只練體能。

options.en: They value both physical practice and judgment.
options.zh: 他們同時重視體能練習和判斷力。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都涵蓋體能以外的培養；金句使用來源對比。
reply.promptEn: What is the rowing club trying to develop?

scene.promptZh: 籃球教練除了練投籃，還讓隊員討論公平競賽和衝突處理。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The coach aims to train the person, not just the body.
options.zh: 教練希望培養整個人，而不只練體能。

options.en: The coach has cancelled shooting practice.
options.zh: 教練已取消投籃練習。

options.en: The team is learning only how to run faster.
options.zh: 球隊只在學習如何跑得更快。

scene.explanationZh: 新增公平與衝突討論，不代表取消體能訓練。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句誤解了 not just 的意思？

options.en: Physical training remains part of the programme.
options.zh: 體能訓練仍是課程一部分。

options.en: The programme should abandon exercise entirely.
options.zh: 課程應完全放棄運動。

options.en: Coaches can also develop judgment and teamwork.
options.zh: 教練也能培養判斷與團隊合作。

contrast.explanationZh: not just 增添其他範疇，並不否定身體訓練。

dialogue.promptZh: 家長問：「為何游泳班還教學生照顧較年幼隊友？」你知道課程同時教水中安全。哪句最完整？

options.en: The academy wants to train the person, not just the body, by teaching safety and responsibility alongside swimming.
options.zh: 學院希望培養整個人，而不只練體能，所以在游泳以外也教安全與責任。

options.en: The class includes water-safety lessons.
options.zh: 課堂包括水中安全。

options.en: Older pupils can help younger teammates.
options.zh: 年長學生可以幫較年幼隊友。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句保留游泳課並解釋安全、責任的加入。

speaking.en: Through practice and reflection, coaches can train the person, not just the body.
speaking.zh: 透過練習與反思，教練可以培養整個人，而不只鍛鍊身體。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出體能以外還培養甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：田徑隊每週練速度，同時讓隊員輪流帶熱身、照顧新生並討論比賽失誤。用一至兩句英文說明教練理念。
writing.selfCheckZh: 保留速度訓練，並指出責任或判斷等體能以外的培養。

examples.en: The coach wants to train the person, not just the body, so runners work on speed while learning to lead and support newcomers.
examples.zh: 教練希望培養整個人，而不只練體能，所以隊員提升速度之餘，也學帶領和照顧新生。

examples.en: To train the person, not just the body, the coach asks runners to take turns leading the warm-up and review race mistakes.
examples.zh: 為了培養整個人而不只練體能，教練讓隊員輪流帶熱身，並檢討比賽失誤。

takeaways.en: The youth club trains the person, not just the body, through teamwork and sport.
takeaways.zh: 青年會藉團隊合作和運動培養整個人，而不只練體能。

takeaways.en: Training the person, not just the body, means building judgment alongside strength.
takeaways.zh: 培養整個人而不只練體能，意指在力量以外也培養判斷力。

brief.meaningEn: A simpler process with fewer hassles and smoother movement.
brief.meaningZh: 流程少些麻煩，通行更順暢。
brief.grammar: The source is about passengers; flow refers to their movement through a service, not liquid.
brief.boundaryZh: 少些麻煩不等於完全沒有規則，也不保證每個人都不用排隊。
brief.misconceptionZh: 要把措施與旅客體驗連起來，不能只用押韻口號。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述一項流程改變如何減少阻滯並改善通行。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 254, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Passengers want less fuss and more flow.

listening.promptZh: 增設指示牌和隊列有甚麼作用？

options.en: They made it easier for passengers to keep moving.
options.zh: 它們令乘客較容易繼續前行。

options.en: They removed the need to show tickets.
options.zh: 它們免去了出示船票的需要。

options.en: They guaranteed no queue at any time.
options.zh: 它們保證任何時候都毋須排隊。

options.en: They sent prepaid passengers to a different pier.
options.zh: 它們把預購票乘客送到另一個碼頭。

listening.explanationZh: 措施減少停下問路的阻滯，但仍需驗票和排隊。
listening.en: At the ferry pier, staff put signs before the ticket gates and opened a second queue for prepaid tickets. Passengers wanted less fuss and more flow, so fewer people had to stop and ask for directions.
listening.zh: 碼頭職員在驗票閘前增設指示牌，並為預購船票者開第二條隊；乘客希望少些麻煩、通行更順暢，因此較少人要停下來問路。

options.en: They wanted clearer directions before the gates.
options.zh: 他們希望閘前指示更清楚。

options.en: They wanted the ticket lines to move smoothly.
options.zh: 他們希望驗票隊列走得更順暢。

options.en: They wanted less fuss and more flow.
options.zh: 他們希望少些麻煩，通行更順暢。

options.en: They wanted fewer unnecessary stops on the way in.
options.zh: 他們希望入閘途中少些不必要的停頓。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指向減少阻滯；金句完整表達來源口號。
reply.promptEn: What improvement did ferry passengers want?

scene.promptZh: 巴士站把付款指示移到候車入口，並保留拍卡程序；乘客較少在車門前找零。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The new signs give passengers less fuss and more flow when boarding.
options.zh: 新指示令乘客上車時少些麻煩，通行更順暢。

options.en: Passengers no longer need to pay a fare.
options.zh: 乘客不再需要付車資。

options.en: Every bus now arrives early.
options.zh: 所有巴士現在都提早到站。

scene.explanationZh: 付款程序仍在，但上車阻滯減少。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把 less fuss 誤說成完全取消必要程序？

options.en: The signs help people find the right line.
options.zh: 指示牌幫人找到正確隊列。

options.en: Nobody has to present a ticket anymore.
options.zh: 所有人都不再需要出示車票。

options.en: A second line may reduce stopping at the gate.
options.zh: 第二條隊可減少閘前停頓。

contrast.explanationZh: 減少麻煩不等於免除驗票。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「為何車站把路線圖移到入閘前？」你知道不少人原本在閘口才停下找路。哪句最完整？

options.en: It gives passengers less fuss and more flow: they can choose a route before reaching the gate.
options.zh: 這讓乘客少些麻煩、通行更順暢：他們可在到達閘口前先選路線。

options.en: The map now stands before the gate.
options.zh: 路線圖現在放在閘前。

options.en: Passengers can check the route earlier.
options.zh: 乘客可以更早查看路線。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出位置調整如何改善通行。

speaking.en: Clear signs can give passengers less fuss and more flow through a busy station.
speaking.zh: 清楚指示可令乘客在繁忙車站少些麻煩、走得更順暢。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出哪個改動令通行更順暢。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校園開放日原本只有一個登記桌，家長常堵在門口問路；校方加設預先登記隊列和入口地圖。用一至兩句英文解釋改善。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出登記和找路的阻滯減少，不要說完全沒有隊列。

examples.en: Families wanted less fuss and more flow at check-in; the extra registration line and entrance map helped them find the right place.
examples.zh: 家長希望登記時少些麻煩、通行更順暢；額外登記隊列和入口地圖幫他們找到正確位置。

examples.en: The aim was less fuss and more flow: registered visitors used a separate line instead of stopping at the door for directions.
examples.zh: 目標是減少麻煩、讓通行更順暢：已登記訪客使用另一條隊，不用在門口停下問路。

takeaways.en: The new gate layout offers travellers less fuss and more flow without skipping security checks.
takeaways.zh: 新閘口布局讓旅客少些麻煩、通行更順暢，同時仍須安檢。

takeaways.en: A clearer boarding lane gave passengers less fuss and more flow at the terminal.
takeaways.zh: 更清楚的登船通道令碼頭乘客少些麻煩、通行更順暢。
